name: Cel-shaded 3D
summary: 3D models drawn to look like a cartoon or an animation cel: light falls in 2 or 3 flat steps, black outlines trace each shape, and colours stay bright and flat. A full 3D world looks hand drawn.

philosophy.core_thesis: Real-time 3D does not need to imitate a photograph; it can imitate a drawing and keep its clarity at any angle.
design_principles: Light each surface in 2 or 3 flat value steps with a hard edge between them.
Draw an outline of 1–4 px around each silhouette and inner crease.
Use saturated flat base colours; add texture only as painted strokes.
Keep shapes simple and exaggerated: big heads, chunky buildings.
Use a bright, clear sky with stylised clouds.
Keep the outline weight the same at any distance from the camera.

projection_and_camera.camera: A free or a following camera in a full 3D world.
projection_and_camera.framing: Wide, clear views with the player at a third of the frame.

geometry.primitive: A polygon mesh with flat normals for clean shading steps.
geometry.edge_rule: Black or dark-hue ink lines on silhouettes and creases.
geometry.proportion: Exaggerated: big hands, round shapes, chunky buildings.

surface.texture_rule: Flat colour fills with a few painted strokes; no photo texture.
surface.material_model: A step ramp: the light value is mapped to 2 or 3 flat tones.

palette.strategy: Bright, saturated base colours with a cool shadow tone of the same hue family.
palette.on_screen_colours: full colour, used in flat areas

lighting.model: Per-pixel light quantised into 2 or 3 steps.
lighting.shadows: Hard-edged cast shadows in one flat tone.
lighting.atmosphere: Stylised clouds, sparkles and speed lines; little fog.
lighting.time_of_day: Swaps of the light and shadow tones: warm for dusk, blue for night.

world_and_space.scale: Slightly enlarged and simplified: wide doors, round buildings.
world_and_space.interiors: Simple rooms with a few iconic props, bright walls and clean floors.
world_and_space.exteriors: Open squares and streets with bold silhouettes and big trees.
world_and_space.threshold: A door opens with no break, or a short fade.

principles.rule: Mark the goal with the highest colour contrast in the frame.
Make doors and props 1.2–1.5 times real scale.
Use 2 layers: one sun and one flat ambient tone.

interface.placement: Bold shapes in the corners, about 5–10% of the screen.
interface.type_and_icons: Rounded display fonts and outlined icons that match the world.
interface.diegesis: Mostly on top, drawn in the same ink style.

canonical_works.work: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker

emotion.target_response: Joyful clarity: the viewer sees a drawn world that is light, bright and easy to read.

avoid_when: The brief needs material truth for a client sale.
The tone must be serious or luxury.

modifiers.how: Drop the outlines; paint light and shade into the textures.
Lock the camera to isometric and remove the outlines for pastel flat faces.

sources.title: Wikipedia: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker
